config.icys-better-horses.title: Icy's Better Horses
config.icys-better-horses.call_key.toolt: Whistles your horse, or opens its info screen while you're riding.
config.icys-better-horses.radial_key.too: Opens the command wheel while looking at an owned horse.
config.icys-better-horses.manage_key.too: Opens the list of every horse you own, wherever they are.
config.icys-better-horses.stabilizer.too: Enable the horse stabilizer gear (gliding descent and safe landings).
config.icys-better-horses.medkit.tooltip: Enable the horse medkit gear (auto-heals the horse when badly hurt).
config.icys-better-horses.hooves.tooltip: Enable the horse hooves gear (reduced fall damage and frost/snow walking).
config.icys-better-horses.horse_exclusiv: Only the owner may ride or open the inventory of an owned horse.
config.icys-better-horses.multiriding.to: Allow a second player to ride behind the owner.
